report_name: Houston City College Data Breach Impacts 832,000 Individuals

identities.name: Houston City College
identities.description: Educational institution that suffered a data breach discovered on May 24, 2026, affecting 832,000 individuals. Exposed data included PII such as Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, and academic records.

indicators.name: Potential Data Staging File 'students.zip'
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Potential Data Staging File 'students.zip'
id: 5b9e1a2b-3c4d-4e5f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a file named 'students.zip', which could indicate data staging prior to exfiltration, as suggested in the analysis of the Houston City College data breach.
references:
  - https://gbhackers.com/cisa-urges-critical-infrastructure-operators-to-isolate-vital-ot-systems/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-29
tags:
  - attack.t1074.001
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\students.zip'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of a file named 'students.zip', which is a common sign of data being staged for exfiltration.

indicators.name: Anomalous Database Query for Student Information
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Database Query for Student Information
id: 1f2a3b4c-5d6e-4f7a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects database queries that may indicate bulk data collection from student information systems, as suggested in the analysis of the Houston City College data breach. This rule is a hunting hint and requires tuning for specific database audit log formats.
references:
  - https://gbhackers.com/cisa-urges-critical-infrastructure-operators-to-isolate-vital-ot-systems/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-29
tags:
  - attack.t1213
  - attack.collection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative or reporting queries.
level: low
logsource:
  category: application
detection:
  keywords:
    - 'SELECT * FROM students'
    - 'SELECT * FROM alumni'
    - 'SELECT * FROM employees'
  condition: keywords
indicators.description: Detects database queries that may indicate bulk data collection from student information systems.

indicators.name: Anomalous Large Outbound Data Transfer
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Large Outbound Data Transfer
id: 6e7f8a9b-0c1d-4e2f-3a4b-5c6d7e8f9a0b
status: experimental
description: Detects unusually large outbound data transfers from internal servers, which could indicate data exfiltration. This is a hunting hint based on the analysis of the Houston City College data breach and requires baselining and tuning.
references:
  - https://gbhackers.com/cisa-urges-critical-infrastructure-operators-to-isolate-vital-ot-systems/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-29
tags:
  - attack.t1041
  - attack.exfiltration
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate large file transfers, backups, or software updates.
level: low
logsource:
  category: firewall
detection:
  selection:
    action: 'allow'
    bytes_out|gt: 104857600 # Placeholder for 100MB, requires tuning
  filter_known_dest:
    dst_ip:
      - 8.8.8.8 # Placeholder for known destinations
  condition: selection and not filter_known_dest
indicators.description: Detects unusually large outbound data transfers from internal servers, which could indicate data exfiltration.
